item.title: Ghana kick-start Afcon 2027 bid despite Ayew penalty miss
item.description:
⚽ Jordan Ayew has a first-half penalty saved as Ghana secure a comfortable 2-0 home win over Somalia to kick-start their Afcon 2027 qualifying campaign.
